title: Goal-State Feedback
hook: You can't fix a gap you've never actually measured.
statement: Self-correct by comparing where you are right now to where you said you'd be.
explainer: Without a number for the target and a number for today, you're just guessing. The size of the gap tells you how hard you need to push.
sop: Set one specific number Target for the area you care about most.
Measure your Current honestly this week.
Subtract Target minus Current. Don't round in your favor.
Take one corrective action sized to that gap.
Re-measure on a fixed schedule, weekly or monthly.
equation_example: Target is 10,000 steps, Current is 6,500. 10,000 - 6,500 = 3,500 steps short. A bigger gap means you need a bigger correction today. Close to zero means you're on track, so leave it alone.
question: Write down one number you care about, its target, and where it actually sits today.
closing_statement: Measure the gap before you try to close it.
caption:
Principle Nº 190: Goal-State Feedback
